What we'll cover

We'll build your profile together, section by section.

No theory-only slides — we walk through each part of a LinkedIn profile live, so you leave with a profile that's actually done, not just a to-do list.

01

A profile picture that gets noticed

The framing, lighting, and expression that make recruiters stop scrolling.

02

A banner that works as your billboard

Turning empty header space into your personal brand statement.

03

A headline that says what you offer

Moving past "Student" or "Fresher" to a line that actually gets read.

04

An About section that tells your story

Who you help, what you're good at, and what to do next — not a copy-pasted résumé.

05

Experience that shows results

Turning job titles into proof of the value you actually brought.

06

Networking & live Q&A

How to reach HR professionals directly, plus your questions, answered live.

Registration isn't connected yet

This form is fully built and ready — it just needs a webhook URL to know where to send submissions.

1. Create a free Zapier (or Make.com) account.

2. New Zap → Trigger: Webhooks by Zapier → Catch Hook. Copy the webhook URL it gives you.

3. Paste that URL into WEBHOOK_URL near the bottom of this file's code.

4. Action step: Notion → Create Database Item, pick the "LinkedIn Webinar Registrations" database, and map each field (name → Name, email → Email, phone → Phone, salary → Current Salary, experience → Years of Experience).

5. Turn the Zap on. Submissions will start landing in Notion automatically.

Until then, people can still reach you at apply@jobifiedjobs.com.
